parent_checkpoint: M2262 selected checkpoint set from selected_checkpoint_rows.csv
parent_objective: execute bounded metric-selected measured validation under the audited soft-boundary workload
blocked_by: fresh executed metric-selected measured validation has not yet been run
current-sim verdict requires later result audit after executed rows exist
supersedes: old-row relabel panels as substitute for fresh metric-selected execution
reset-only preflight as substitute for measured driving evidence

public_gates: M2445 must use M2443 workload/preflight artifacts as the executed denominator
M2445 must execute exactly 350 reset targets x 15 selected checkpoints unless it fails closed with explicit gaps
M2445 must enable soft_offtrack_metric_enabled true and soft_offtrack_tolerance_m 0.20
M2445 must preserve actor inputs and avoid hidden/oracle feature injection
M2445 must write episode rows, aggregate metrics, validation failures, and decision rows
M2445 must not execute repair, train, replay/PPO, rank candidates/controllers, select winners, promote checkpoints, or make paper/current-sim/self-ID verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim actual success improvement before result audit
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes the audited metric-selected measured-validation workload under the hard/soft task boundary
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: executed measured-validation artifact only; no repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if workload coverage differs from M2443 without explicit fail-closed gaps
stop if actor input contract changes
stop if implementation claims a verdict before result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit if full measured validation completes
route to execution repair if implementation fails before policy rollout completion
stop for user review if measured validation is too resource-heavy or unsupported

admission_evidence: M2443 materialized 5250 workload cells with no missing or duplicate source cells
M2443 reset success 350/350 with unchanged actor observation shape
blocked_shortcuts: no current-sim verdict before result audit
allowed_updates: M2445 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the implementation result
next_stage_criteria: executed episode rows cover the M2443 denominator or fail closed
a bounded result-audit route is registered

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2445 measures task-boundary outcomes and does not by itself test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None required in M2445; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict should be claimed.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured validation remains offtrack-dominated, route to result audit/localization/synthesis rather than training or repair by default.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim before audit

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: produces fresh executed measured-validation rows under the selected task boundary
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can provide current-sim task-quality evidence for later audit; cannot itself establish paper verdict without audit and comparison
must_synthesize_if: full measured validation cannot run and another preflight-only task is proposed
M2445 repeats old-row relabeling instead of execution
result interpretation attempts to claim verdict before audit

hypothesis: The audited M2443 workload can be executed as a bounded metric-selected measured validation under soft-boundary task metrics without repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
success_criteria: episode rows cover the M2443 350 x 15 denominator or fail closed with explicit coverage gaps
soft-boundary hard/soft task metrics are recorded
a bounded result-audit route is selected
failure_criteria: M2445 ranks candidate families or controllers
M2445 selects a winner or promotes a checkpoint
M2445 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID verdict claims
decision_rule: M2445 passes if it executes or fail-closes the audited metric-selected measured-validation workload and routes to result audit without repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
